displayDescription: A seed-idea sprouts vines, then blooms, and one tendril links them into a connected system inside a night-garden Art Nouveau frame.
styleRenderer: SVG (native browser vector: paths, <use> ornament groups, textPath, masks, fixed-seed feTurbulence grain)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track, music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: No reviewed source frames matched this style (BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json: 0 sources, no contact sheets) and STYLE.json lists no preview_recipes; the refresh shows a scene-dependent dark-ground alternative based on the original style definition, with no source observations.

Ground #1F3128 is a deeper shade in the #293E32 ink family, chosen for a night-garden lithograph mood. It replaces the earlier cream example swatch, as background_policy is scene_dependent. Cream #F3ECD9 now acts as the print-light ink for lettering (contrast 11.65:1).
The nimbus uses #788659 at 32% alpha over the ground; this is deterministic transparency, not a new base hue.
Lithographic paper grain is a stationary procedural SVG feTurbulence approximation (fixed seed), not scanned print texture.

Typography uses OS-bundled macOS Didot, with Bodoni 72, Iowan Old Style and Georgia as fallbacks. @font-face src: local() declarations point to these installed faces; no font files are embedded, so a renderer without these system faces falls back to Georgia/serif.
Motion is not used because the engine is GSAP-only, giving one owner per property; no Blender or 3D renderer was used, per user instruction.
Rendering and browser QA have not been run by the agent; the host performs them.
